title: Label: Champagne Blanc de Noirs
scenario: **Maison Lambert** · **CHAMPAGNE** · **Blanc de Noirs** · **Extra Brut** · **Millésime 2015** · 12.5% vol · 750 ml

questions.stem: Which grape is a Blanc de Noirs made from? (two words)
questions.explanation: Pinot Noir only. Blanc de Blancs is Chardonnay only.

questions.stem: How much residual sugar does **Extra Brut** allow?
questions.explanation: Extra brut <6. Brut <15, Extra dry 12–20, Demi-sec 33–50.

choices: most of the cuvée is from the 2015 harvest
the wine aged 2015 days on its yeast lees
the bottle is number 2015 of a limited run
the house was founded back in the year 2015
questions.explanation: Millésime: more than 85% of the cuvée comes from one good year.

questions.stem: The bubbles in this wine came from a second fermentation in a stainless-steel tank.
questions.explanation: Champagne re-ferments in the bottle (Méthode Champenoise). The tank method is Charmat/Martinotti.

questions.stem: How was the yeast removed from this bottle before the final cork?
choices: settled out in a cold INOX tank
frozen in the neck and ejected
questions.explanation: After remuage gathers the yeast in the neck, it is frozen and ejected à la volée; then liqueur d'expédition is added.
